en:
## New Features

- Live streaming output now renders inside the message document instead of as a separate overlay, so it no longer disappears when you scroll up while the model is still writing
- New read-only file viewer panel with raw, markdown and structured tree (JSON / TOML / INI) views, openable from file attachments and tool cards
- System- and AI-injected turns (auto-continuation, review kickoff, rebase, batch merge, scheduled tasks, group chat, IM gateway) are now labelled as such instead of appearing as messages you typed
- Compaction and the reflection gates now show thinking progress, so a model that reasons before answering no longer sits at "0 chars"
- Pull down on the header to reload — useful in an installed PWA, where there is no browser reload button
- Built-in gateway static API keys (ksk_...) are accepted as credentials, and can be pasted as a bare key list without JSON wrapping
- Virtual-list mode gains the fullscreen content viewer (per-body wrap / source / copy) the classic view already had

## Improvements

- Streaming markdown is prepared incrementally, and a hidden quadratic lookup in the document rebuild is now bounded, so long turns stay responsive
- Output-stats ticks that carry no change no longer re-render the whole app shell once per second
- Every route and lazily loaded overlay has its own error boundary, so a single failure cannot unmount the whole app
- Update messages describe what is happening to your session in plain language, and state outright that scheduling an update lets running work finish first
- Zooming the virtual list anchors on the pointer instead of the viewport top

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed history silently refusing to load older messages after any tool completed
- Fixed cards growing taller on their own after an async fetch: a truncated body reserves its full height up front, and full content is fetched only when you ask for it
- Structured tool cards (Recall / KnowledgeSearch / WebSearch / Share) no longer degrade into a raw JSON dump when a payload is truncated
- Fixed requests rejected with "duplicate tool_use id" when an upstream reuses the same tool-call id for every call
- Fixed a stalled turn being silently truncated as a clean end of stream, and gateway adapter tool calls stranded at \"initializing\" on a half-open connection
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 流式输出改为直接渲染在消息文档内，不再是独立浮层：模型还在输出时向上滚动，内容不会再消失
- 新增只读文件查看面板，支持原文、Markdown 渲染和结构化树（JSON / TOML / INI）三种视图，可从文件附件和工具卡片打开
- 系统和 AI 注入的消息（自动续跑、评审启动、rebase、批量合并、定时任务、群聊、IM 网关）现在会明确标注来源，不再显示成你手动输入的消息
- 压缩和四类反射门现在会显示思考进度，先思考再回答的模型不会再长时间停在「0 字符」
- 下拉顶栏即可重新加载 —— 已安装的 PWA 没有浏览器刷新按钮，这个手势正好补上
- 支持内置网关静态 API Key（ksk_...）作为凭据，可直接粘贴裸 key 列表，无需包成 JSON
- 虚拟列表模式补齐了经典视图已有的全屏内容查看器（按内容块换行 / 查看源码 / 复制）

## 改进

- 流式 Markdown 改为增量解析，文档重建中隐藏的平方级查找也已收敛，长回答期间界面保持流畅
- 数值没有变化的输出统计推送不再每秒触发整个应用外壳重新渲染
- 每个路由和懒加载浮层都有独立的错误边界，单点失败不会再让整个应用白屏
- 更新提示改用用户视角的表述，并明确说明：安排更新不会打断正在运行的工作，会等它做完
- 虚拟列表缩放以指针位置为锚点，不再固定在视口顶部

## 修复

- 修复任意工具执行完成后，向上滚动就再也加载不出更早历史的问题
- 修复卡片在异步加载后自行变高的问题：截断内容现在一开始就预留完整高度，完整内容只在你主动点击时才拉取
- 修复载荷被截断时，结构化工具卡片（Recall / KnowledgeSearch / WebSearch / Share）退化成原始 JSON 的问题
- 修复上游对每次工具调用复用同一个 id 时，请求被「duplicate tool_use id」拒绝的问题
- 修复流中断被误判为正常结束、导致回答被静默截断的问题，以及半开连接下网关适配器工具调用卡在「初始化中」的问题
